newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Volume in well-supported Belgian OLOs to stay thin.
newsitem.headline: Volume in well-supported Belgian OLOs to stay thin.

text.p: Belgian bonds edged up with Bunds in early trade on Tuesday after U.S. Treasuries prices rose overnight, but volumes remained thin and dealers expected prices to stay around current levels all week.
"People are preparing for the year-end...this week the U.S. market closes early for Thanksgiving (on Thursday)...I expect consolidation," one dealer said.

The undertone remained bullish, however. "(Investors) don't see any reason why yields should go up and people are staying confident," he added. By 0945 GMT the benchmark 2006 OLO yielded 5.96 percent, down from 5.98 percent at Monday's close.
